arguments.command:
sqlite3 ../data/current.db "
WITH att AS (SELECT operation_id, COUNT(*) natt, MAX(CASE WHEN attempt_no=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dummy FROM attempt_events GROUP BY 1),
ops AS (
 SELECT lo.operation_id, sr.service_id, a.natt,
  (SELECT ra.pool_id FROM route_assignments ra WHERE ra.route_id=lo.route_id AND ra.effective_from_ms<=lo.opened_at_ms AND ra.effective_to_ms>lo.opened_at_ms) AS pool_id
 FROM logical_operations lo JOIN service_routes sr ON sr.route_id=lo.route_id
 LEFT JOIN att a ON a.operation_id=lo.operation_id
 WHERE lo.opened_at_ms>=1777629600000 AND lo.opened_at_ms<1777633200000),
fin AS (SELECT operation_id, MAX(attempt_no) mx FROM attempt_events GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.service_code,
 COUNT(*) operations, SUM(o.natt) attempts,
 SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) failed_attempts,
 SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 AND a.attempt_no=f.mx THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) terminal_failures,
 SUM(CASE WHEN o.natt>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) retried,
 COUNT(DISTINCT o.pool_id) physical_pools
FROM ops o JOIN services s USING(service_id) JOIN attempt_events a ON a.operation_id=o.operation_id JOIN failure_codes fc ON fc.code_id=a.code_id JOIN fin f ON f.operation_id=o.operation_id
GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL
SELECT 'TOTAL',COUNT(*),SUM(natt),SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
 SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 AND a.attempt_no=f.mx THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
 SUM(CASE WHEN natt>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),COUNT(DISTINCT pool_id)
FROM ops o JOIN attempt_events a ON a.operation_id=o.operation_id JOIN failure_codes fc ON fc.code_id=a.code_id JOIN fin f ON f.operation_id=o.operation_id;"
